newsitem.title: USA: Thieves steal $1.5 million from armored car.
newsitem.headline: Thieves steal $1.5 million from armored car.

text.p: At least two people broke into an armoured vehicle in a parking lot in western Massachusetts early Friday and stole some $1.5 million, police said.
"They accessed the truck, took the money, threw it over the fence to another vehicle that was waiting," West Springfield Police Sgt. Paul Finnie said.
West Springfield is about a two-hour drive due west of Boston. There was no indication that the thieves used force to get into the truck, Finnie said.
There were no witnesses or injuries in the incident, he said, adding that the investigation was continuing.
The money was to be transferred to another truck and transported to the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston in downtown Boston, he said.
